posts.text: What role should tariffs play in U.S.-China trade negotiations? Kari Heerman analyzes the U.S.-China Board of Trade's proposal on "non-sensitive" goods and explains why policymakers may face difficult tradeoffs if relief isn't paired with meaningful gains for U.S. exporters.
posts.summary: Tariff relief requires meaningful U.S. exporter gains

posts.text: The EU has now sanctioned 671 Russian "shadow fleet" oil tankers, up from just 25 in 2024. The UK has sanctioned 621. Robin Brooks and Ben Harris find the U.S. hasn't added any since early 2025—a gap that's limiting the sanctions' overall impact.
